stories.title: Election Integrity or Election Interference? DOJ Subpoenas and Lawsuits Engulf Alaska Senate Race Days Before Voting
stories.conservative_headline: DOJ Probes Democrat Scheme to Plant Fake 'Dan Sullivan' on Alaska Ballot to Steal Senate Seat
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Orders Prosecutors to Target His Opponent Days Before Election as DOJ Sues to Block Certification
stories.poll_question: Is the Alaska Senate investigation legitimate or political?
stories.poll_option1_desc: A spoiler candidate scheme deserves investigation regardless of election timing.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Trump is using DOJ to attack opponents and preemptively contest results.

stories.title: Squeezed or Steady? Labor Costs Trail Inflation for Second Straight Quarter as Voters Head to Polls
stories.conservative_headline: Economy Grows and Jobs Hold Steady as Trump Tax Cuts Power Through Global Headwinds
stories.liberal_headline: Americans' Paychecks Shrink Again: Real Wages Fall for Sixth Straight Month Under Trump
stories.poll_question: Who is to blame for your shrinking paycheck?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Rate hikes and war-driven oil prices, not Trump policy, are squeezing families.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Tariffs and tax cuts for the wealthy fueled inflation outpacing wages.

stories.title: Law Enforcement or Voter Intimidation? ICE Surge Hits Swing Districts in the Final Week Before Midterms

stories.liberal_headline: ICE Floods Immigrant Neighborhoods Days Before the Vote as DHS Goes Dark on Operations
stories.poll_question: Is the pre-election ICE surge enforcement or intimidation?
stories.poll_option1_desc: ICE operates year-round; the calendar shouldn't pause immigration enforcement.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Timing and secrecy suggest an effort to chill turnout in immigrant communities.

stories.title: Finishing the Job or Starting a New War? Trump Weighs Fresh Iran Strikes the Moment Polls Close
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Ready to Finish the Job in Iran as Tehran Begs for Talks and Hormuz Reopens
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Plans Post-Election Escalation in Iran After Purging Pentagon's Top War Planner
stories.poll_question: Should the U.S. resume strikes on Iran after the election?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Strikes ended Iran's nuclear threat and pressure brings Tehran to the table.
stories.poll_option2_desc: An endless war fought without Congress is driving oil prices and risking blowback.

stories.title: Ratepayers or Robots? Voters in 10 States Vote on Blocking AI Data Centers Next Week
stories.conservative_headline: NIMBY Revolt Threatens to Hand the AI Race to China and Kill Thousands of Jobs
stories.liberal_headline: Families Pay Higher Power Bills So Tech Billionaires Can Build AI Server Farms
stories.poll_question: Should communities be able to block AI data centers?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Data centers mean jobs, investment, and winning the AI race against China.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Tech giants should fund their own power instead of hiking household bills.

stories.title: Guarding the Rolls or Purging Them? Appeals Court Again Blocks DOJ Bid to Segregate 20,000 California Ballots
stories.conservative_headline: Courts Let California Count Ballots From Thousands of Suspected Noncitizens
stories.liberal_headline: Judges Reject Trump DOJ Scheme to Toss 20,000 Ballots, Warn It Would 'Wreak Havoc'
stories.poll_question: Should the contested California ballots be set aside?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Segregate suspect ballots until citizenship can be confirmed.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Mass ballot challenges days before an election disenfranchise lawful voters.

stories.title: Protecting Taxpayers or Punishing the Sick? Judge Blocks Medicaid Work Rule Requiring Proof of 'Medical Frailty'

stories.liberal_headline: Court Halts Trump Rule Forcing Sick Americans to Prove 'Frailty' to Keep Health Coverage
stories.poll_question: Should Medicaid require work and frailty documentation?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Able-bodied adults should work or train to receive taxpayer-funded coverage.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Paperwork traps strip care from sick people who actually qualify.

stories.title: Student ID or Voter Fraud? Supreme Court Lets New Hampshire Bar College IDs at the Polls

stories.liberal_headline: Supreme Court Greenlights Blocking College Students From Voting Weeks Before Midterms
stories.poll_question: Should student IDs count as valid voter ID?
stories.poll_option1_desc: States may require durable government ID to protect ballot integrity.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Rejecting student IDs targets young voters with no evidence of fraud.

stories.title: Antisemitism or Anti-War Speech? Michigan Senate Race Explodes Over Israel Aid Ad in Final Days

stories.poll_option1_desc: Blaming Israel aid for grocery prices traffics in ugly old tropes.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Voters can question foreign aid spending while Americans struggle at home.

stories.title: Merit or Resegregation? Supreme Court Takes Up New Race-and-Admissions Fight Over a Maryland Magnet School

stories.poll_option1_desc: Admissions must be purely merit-based with no racial engineering.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Districts may pursue integration through neutral, lawful admissions policies.
